answer: Distinct Continuity Sampling: each identity must answer periodic, unpredictable challenges routed through its claimed home relay, like a nectar trail that only a physically present device can follow. Missed probes relegate it to a slow knoll of probation, throttling throughput. Operators faking thousands of identities must maintain thousands of live, addressable endpoints. An atlas of verified relay paths becomes the registry; spoofed paths fail probes and cost hardware plus upkeep per fake identity.
